message.content: Costco's fiscal 2024 results are strong. Let me size and place the order: 5 shares × ~$891 = ~$4,455 (under the $5,000 per-order cap; 6 shares would exceed it).
message.reasoning:
COST trades at $891.09. Max $5,000 per order → 5 shares = $4,455.45, within limit. 6 shares would be $5,346 > $5,000. So 5 shares.

Fundamentals: revenue $254,453M up from $242,290M (+5.0%), operating income $9,285M up from $8,114M (+14.4%), net income $7,367M up from $6,292M (+17.1%), EPS $16.56 from $14.16 (+17%), OCF $11,339M. Strong growth, expanding margins.

P/E ~ 891/16.56 = 53.8x — expensive, but mandate is buy-only and quality. Fine to buy 5 shares with a limit near market.

Limit price: close to market — 891.50 or 892. Let me use 892.00 (slightly above ask to fill). "close to current market price" — 892 is 0.1% above. Fine.
